notes: The competing reading of the closing clause was to make the prepositional phrase for the Levites the predicate and hang the copula on its preposition (rule 49); the ASV renders that preposition of the Levites, leaving the nominal as the only anchor for the supplied frame.
The alternative rendering in the margin was read and set aside under rule 38.
for each supplies both the preposition and the pronoun in a clause writing neither, so the whole phrase is added (rules 30, 33).
